description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans streaming providers, specifically testing provider configuration, error injection, service ID consistency after silo restart, and handling of missing configurations. It defines a test class with fixtures and multiple test methods, along with inner classes for configuring test clusters and silos.

classes.name: StreamProvidersTests_ProviderConfigNotLoaded
classes.description: A unit test class for testing error scenarios related to stream provider configuration not being loaded, implementing tests for configuration errors and service ID consistency.

methods.name: ProvidersTests_ConfigNotLoaded
methods.description: Tests that consuming a stream with an unloaded provider configuration throws a KeyNotFoundException.

methods.name: ServiceId_ProviderRuntime
methods.description: Verifies that the service ID in the provider runtime matches the test cluster's service ID.

methods.name: ServiceId_SiloRestart
methods.description: Ensures that the service ID remains consistent across silo restarts.

inner_classes.name: Fixture
inner_classes.description: Configures and manages the test cluster for the streaming provider tests, including setting service ID and silo configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with initial silo count and a custom silo host configurator.

inner_classes.name: SiloHostConfigurator
inner_classes.description: Configures individual silos in the test cluster, including adding in-memory storage and error injection providers, and registering services.

methods.name: ProvidersTests_ConfigNotLoaded
methods.description: Test method that verifies an exception is thrown when attempting to join a stream for a configuration that isn't loaded.

methods.name: ServiceId_ProviderRuntime
methods.description: Test method that checks if the service ID reported by the provider runtime matches the cluster's service ID.

methods.name: ServiceId_SiloRestart
methods.description: Test method that restarts silos and verifies the service ID remains consistent across restarts.
